video_title: “I have put a lot of work in” Jakob Poeltl on training to ensure healthy season

quotes.speaker: Jakob Poeltl
quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl reflects on his long journey with the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: It feels great, honestly. It makes me feel a little bit older as well. But it's cool to reminisce.
quotes.quote: It feels great, honestly. It makes me feel a little bit older as well. But it's cool to reminisce on these moments, on these times, because it is really where it all started for me. And I feel like we've all come a long way since then.

quotes.speaker: Jakob Poeltl
quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl on the growth of former Raptors teammates
quotes.excerpt: All of us had our moments early on in our careers where you had to fight through some adversity.
quotes.quote: All of us had our moments early on in our careers where you had to fight through some adversity. Maybe you weren't getting the minutes, we weren't guys that just got out there and were playing 30 minutes a night right from the jump. So it's cool to see everybody thriving and doing well in this league.

quotes.speaker: Jakob Poeltl
quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl on the impact of playing with Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: He does so much for us on both sides of the court. He brings that veteran leadership as well.
quotes.quote: He is a really good player. He does so much for us on both sides of the court. He brings that veteran leadership as well. It's the whole package for us. Definitely a type of player that we haven't had in this way in the past, so I'm hoping it's going to be really positive.

quotes.speaker: Jakob Poeltl
quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl on his offseason training and health focus
quotes.excerpt: I have put a lot of work in, especially with my mobility, strength and conditioning program over the summer.
quotes.quote: I have put a lot of work in, especially with my mobility, strength and conditioning program over the summer. It's one of those situations where it felt out of my control at times last year. So just trying to take more control of the situation, doing my best to get as ready as possible and then rolling with the punches as the season comes.

quotes.speaker: Jakob Poeltl
quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl on team accountability and feedback
quotes.excerpt: We try to look inward as a team. We obviously lean on each other as teammates.
quotes.quote: We try to look inward as a team. We obviously lean on each other as teammates. We try to hold each other accountable at the same time. So really the feedback that I'm looking for comes from my teammates, comes from my coaches. For them to appreciate what I do for the team makes me want to keep going and try to help the team win anywhere I can.
